_comment: Edit decisions for edit.mjs (storyboard §2 post, §3 per-shot Post lines, §5 mix, §6 9:16, §8 step 7). Frame numbers are each cut's own (60 fps). The shot list is shots.mjs, the 15 s mapping is CUT15_SEGMENTS in mg-timeline.mjs, flashes/shakes/rgbashift/pushes/bumps come from post() there. Speed ramps are baked in at capture (real in-engine time scaling), so the edit never retimes footage.

grade._comment: Storyboard §2 Colour grade, the same chain on every gameplay frame. Not on the S04 photo and the S05 champion over the same blurred world (f120-239, one look across the match cut); the end-card type is composited after the grade. The grain is laid on in RGB before the 4:2:0 conversion (it dithers the conversion).

chroma._comment: rgbashift. strong (4 px) = post().rgb impact frames; light (2 px) = transition accents on the whip, the match cut and the big impacts.

push._comment: Digital push-ins: none. S19 is the gameplay camera 1:1 with its full HUD; S13's wheel and S14's bark are framed natively.

bump._comment: Skin-flip scale bumps (S22): 1.04 on the beat, back to 1.00 by frame 4.

band._comment: §6 S19 in 9:16 is now captured natively (a phone held upright, 360x640 CSS px at DPR 3 = 1080x1920, the touch HUD), so no band is built; the band stays for a landscape capture (any frame whose size is not 1080x1920).

poster._comment: §8 thumbnails: S08 frame f398 (Avietė's Short Circuit on Sir Brutus, Ficus card) with the game's logo and end-card lines from the 30 s overlay.

audio._comment: Mix from score.mjs stems: the music ducks under the sfx + game sounds (impacts), then glue, gain to -14 LUFS, a latency-free true-peak limiter, the end fade and digital silence.
audio._tp: the WAV must measure <= maxTruePeakWavDb so the AAC encode stays <= maxTruePeakDb
audio._sections: Energy curve: [from, to, dB] with an 8-frame ramp at each end, before the glue. The gameplay body plays at full level; bar 9 steps down, the COMEBACK key lift steps up, the tower and the core impact are the loudest moments, and the end card holds the body's level (about -15 LUFS-S) with a stab on every line.
